summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors on Ithaca, who received jewelled earrings from his squires during the wooers' gift-giving and was slain by Odysseus when the hall ran with blood.

story.text: When the suitors brought gifts to win Penelope, Eurydamas' squires brought him a pair of earrings with three clustering drops — bright among the gold and amber the wooers laid before the queen.
In the slaughter of the suitors Odysseus smote Eurydamas among the throng as spears flew and the faithful servants locked the doors — one of the many wooers who had devoured the king's house.
